guards_reviewed.artifact_bounds: Prehashes bounded required artifacts, verifies stable file identity across hash/load, checks selected model and epoch-2 checkpoint digests against provenance, and caps the seven-file aggregate at 128 MB.
guards_reviewed.counters: Requires three withheld-evaluation epochs, each with 7,460 optimizer attempts/completed updates, 373 completed batches, zero skipped updates, and zero nonfinite gradient steps; total 22,380 updates and 1,119 batches.
guards_reviewed.execution_caps: Stages only the pinned checker/helper and JSON metadata; runs CPU-only with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, 50% CPU quota, 1.4-GB MemoryHigh, 1.5-GB MemoryMax, zero swap, 600-second runtime, and create-only output receipts.
guards_reviewed.fresh_wrapper_gates: Before staging/launch, binds the exact S5 native invocation and successful exit; verifies pinned metadata bytes, exact 164-file source tree/content, split digest, registered data stat identities, terminal artifact presence/size bounds, absent verifier unit/output, no stop marker, parent 2-core/18-GB-high/20-GB-max/swap-zero envelope, fresh cgroup population/headroom, persistent scratch and disk headroom.
guards_reviewed.model_and_normalization: Checks the exact 211-input/23-output GRU tensor inventory, shapes, 2,159,639 parameters, FP32 finite tensors, canonical source-bound normalization identities, and matching selected/checkpoint/resume-model fingerprints.
guards_reviewed.optimizer_and_resume: Checks exact three-group Muon/AdamW shape and membership, FP32 finite state, 22,380 AdamW steps, momentum state, next_epoch=3 and fixed epoch boundary; rebinds contract options to seed 5, the exact launched CLI, split and data identities, source files, one runtime thread, and TF32 disabled.
guards_reviewed.restricted_loader: Uses torch.load(weights_only=True) with the narrow observed NumPy/RNG and torch.torch_version.TorchVersion safe-global allowlist; the shared helper is byte-identical to the reviewed S4 helper.
guards_reviewed.source_manifest: Requires the exact manifest SHA, commit, exactly 164 unique paths, admission-map equality, bounded aggregate source bytes, safe relative paths, and fresh SHA-256 checks of every source file.
guards_reviewed.split_and_membership: Rehashes the fixed split; reconstructs seed-5 train order and fixed evaluation order; validates ordered train/fit-valid/evaluation group lists, expected counts, dataset identity, and component-disjoint fit/evaluation membership.
guards_reviewed.terminal_identity: Binds recipe, admission, launch, launch acceptance, S5 run/unit/invocation, and S5 terminal-evidence raw digest; requires successful exited native state and integer main_pid=0, exec_main_code=1, exec_main_status=0.
